one_line: Committed MD&A text corpus: ticker_data/ holds 135 per-ticker .parquet files (repo ~210 MB) with columns CIK, ticker, report year and extracted 10-K MD&A text, built with sec_edgar_downloader + BeautifulSoup; includes BKNG.parquet (849 KB), MAR.parquet (940 KB) and UBER.parquet (179 KB) but NOT ABNB, EXPE or HLT; plus processing_status.csv (471 KB) and run logs; licence is a custom but MIT-equivalent permissive text (GitHub reports NOASSERTION); 17 stars, last push 11 Feb 2024.
abnb_use: Gap 15 / management-tone work: gives a ready cross-sectional MD&A panel for two direct lodging/OTA comparables (BKNG, MAR) plus 133 large caps, so peer 'tone' or topic scores can be benchmarked against a market-wide distribution rather than read in isolation — our earlier management-tone test failed on our own construction, and a cross-sectional baseline is exactly the missing ingredient. Annual 10-K cadence only, so it reads on narrative, not on quarterly nights/ADR.
sample_plan: git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/pChitral/ETL-SEC-EDGAR-10-k-Filings.git && cd ETL-SEC-EDGAR-10-k-Filings && git sparse-checkout set ticker_data/BKNG.parquet ticker_data/MAR.parquet ticker_data/UBER.parquet processing_status.csv README.md LICENSE  — total ~2.5 MB. Do NOT check out the rest of ticker_data (~200 MB) or the *.out logs (19 MB + 2 MB). Then report each parquet's schema, row count and min/max report year (python: pandas.read_parquet).
